svg.text: The one rule that breaks everything

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NEVER call blocking code inside a coroutine.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: time.sleep(5), requests.get(), a synchronous DB driver

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: or heavy CPU work will freeze EVERY other task, because

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: they all share this single thread.
